name: atlantidaos
description: AtlantidaOS - World-Class Multi-Provider Autonomous AI Operating System & Command Center Dashboard
author: AtlantidaOS Team

scripts.dev: rm -rf apps/web/.next && PORT=3001 node --experimental-strip-types server.ts & npm --prefix apps/web run dev
scripts.build: NODE_ENV=production NEXT_PUBLIC_EXPORT=true npm --prefix apps/web run build && rm -rf dist build out apps/web/dist && mkdir -p dist build out apps/web/dist && cp -r apps/web/.next-build/. dist/ && cp -r apps/web/.next-build/. build/ && cp -r apps/web/.next-build/. out/ && cp -r apps/web/.next-build/. apps/web/dist/
